draft.subject: Question about Gather AI's perception stack
draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology, and I do computer perception and embedded robotics work that sits close to what you have built at Gather AI. I saw the Robotics Engineer opening on the Autonomy team and wanted to reach out to you directly given your background in perception and machine learning for robotics.

Most of my work has been on the same perception feeding embedded control pattern your MHE Vision line runs on. I built a turret that runs a vision model on a Jetson and hands detection results to an STM32 for actuation, and separately built out full ROS2 kinematics and motion planning on a physical UR5e arm.

I would value the chance to hear about the company and your experience as a long serving member of the company if you have a few minutes sometime.
draft.hook_used: Same technical domain: Daniel is Chief ML Scientist doing perception and ML for robotics, direct overlap with your work
